Kuvitus: hämärä laboratorio. Pöydällä on: Illustration: a dim laboratory. On the table are a laser, whose light is dimmed with filters, a double-slit plate and a screen. The beam of light is so weak that it is drawn as a dashed line. On the screen are red dots that become denser into vertical fringes. Next to the table, a counter shows on the screen of a detector.
Kaavakuva: kaksoisrakokokeen varjostin k: Schematic figure: the screen of a double-slit experiment in three stages, when single photons or electrons hit it one at a time. After 10 hits the points look random, after 200 hits the fringes begin to stand out, and after 5000 hits a clear fringe pattern is visible. At the bottom is the intensity according to the wave model, whose peaks are at the same places as the densest fringes of points. The points have been drawn from the probability distribution of the model.
Kaavakuva kolmesta osumajakaumasta samal: Schematic figure of three hit distributions on the same screen. On the left only one slit is open: a single wide peak without fringes. In the middle both slits are open: a fringe pattern with hardly any hits in its dark places, although in the one-slit pattern there are many hits there. On the right both slits are open, but the path is measured: the fringes disappear, and the distribution is the sum of two one-slit patterns. The vertical axes are the number of hits with the same total number of hits, with no numerical values.
Comptonin ilmiö periaatekuvana, ei mitta: The Compton effect as a schematic figure, not to scale. Before: an X-ray photon of energy hf comes from the left towards an electron at rest. After: the photon scatters obliquely upwards, and its wavelength is longer and its energy hf' smaller; the electron starts to move obliquely downwards, and its velocity is shown by the blue arrow. Below, the violet momentum arrows: the momentum of the incident photon is the vector sum of the momenta of the scattered photon and the electron.
